name: Scripture
author: David JM
description: Shows a random Scripture verse on the full-screen dark scrim Omarchy's speed tests use. ESV when an api.esv.org key is set; World English Bible otherwise.

barWidget.description: One bar icon that shows a random Bible verse centered on a full-screen dark scrim — no card, like the Omarchy speed tests. Esc, the scrim, or the icon again closes it.

schema.label: ESV API key (api.esv.org)
schema.description: Free key from api.esv.org (Create Application). Enables the English Standard Version. Leave empty to fall back to the World English Bible via bible-api.com.
